meaning: The Most or Entirely Merciful — whose mercy encompasses all of creation without condition.
The Especially Merciful — whose special, deep mercy is reserved for the believers.
The King and Owner of Dominion — sovereign ruler over all kingdoms and dominions.
The Absolutely Pure and Perfect — free from every deficiency, flaw, and imperfection.
The Perfection and Giver of Peace — the source of all safety, security, and peace.
The Granter of Security and Faith — gives faith, security, and protection to His servants.
The Guardian, The Witness, The Overseer — watches over and controls all affairs.
The Almighty, The All-Powerful, The Invincible, The Honorable — unconquerable in all matters.
The Compeller, The Restorer — compels by His will and restores the broken.
The Supreme, The Majestic — possesses all greatness; pride and supremacy belong to Him alone.
The Creator, The Maker — brings all things into existence from nothing.
The Originator, The Inventor — fashions creation free from any prior model or example.
The Fashioner, The Shaper — gives each created thing its unique and precise form.
The Constant Forgiver, The Great Forgiver — forgives sins repeatedly for those who repent.
The Subduer, The Ever-Dominating — irresistibly overpowers all things in existence.
The Giver of Gifts, The Bestower — gives generously without condition or expectation of return.
The Ever-Providing, The Constant Provider — provision flows continuously from His generosity.
The Opener, The Judge — opens gates of provision, mercy, and victory for His servants.
The All-Knowing, The Omniscient — possesses complete and perfect knowledge of all things.
The Withholder, The Restrainer — withholds provision and matters by His perfect wisdom.
The Extender, The Expander — expands provision and mercy generously by His grace.
The Reducer, The Abaser — lowers and humbles whom He wills by His just decree.
The Exalter, The Elevator — raises and elevates whom He wills in rank and honour.
The Honourer, The Bestower of Honor — gives dignity and honour to whom He wills.
The Dishonourer, The Humiliator — brings low whoever He wills by His just decree.
The All-Hearing — hears every sound, whisper, and prayer without any limit.
The All-Seeing — nothing in existence is hidden from His perfect sight.
The Judge, The Giver of Justice — the ultimate arbitrator whose judgment is perfectly just.
The Utterly Just — absolute in fairness; never wrongs any soul even by an atom.
The Most Gentle, The Subtle One — knows the finest details and is tender with His servants.
The All-Aware, The All-Acquainted — intimately acquainted with every hidden and apparent matter.
The Most Forbearing — slow to anger; shows immense patience with His servants.
The Magnificent, The Supreme — possessing all greatness, grandeur, and majesty.
The Forgiving, The Exceedingly Forgiving — forgives abundantly and covers sins with mercy.
The Most Appreciative — acknowledges and multiplies rewards far beyond what is deserved.
The Most High, The Exalted — supreme in status and rank above all of creation.
The Greatest, The Most Grand — incomparably great in every dimension and attribute.
The Preserver, The All-Heedful and All-Protecting — guards and protects all things.
The Sustainer, The Maintainer — sustains and provides nourishment to every creature.
The Reckoner — keeps perfect, complete account of every deed, large or small.
The Majestic — full of majesty, glory, and grandeur befitting only His Divine essence.
The Most Generous, The Most Noble — generous beyond measure without expectation of return.
The Watchful, The All-Watchful — ever-observant over all actions, words, and intentions.
The Responsive, The Answerer — answers the call of every sincere supplicant.
The All-Encompassing, The Boundless — boundless in mercy, knowledge, and generosity.
The All-Wise — acts with perfect, complete wisdom in all His decrees and creation.
The Most Loving — full of deep affection and love toward His righteous servants.
The All-Glorious, The Ever-Majestic — full of glory, honour, and eternal majesty.
The Infuser of New Life, The Resurrector — raises the dead and sends messengers to mankind.
The All-Witnessing — present and bearing witness to all that occurs at all times.
The Absolute Truth — He alone is reality; all else is contingent and dependent upon Him.
The Trustee, The Disposer of Affairs — the best disposer of all affairs for those who rely on Him.
The All-Strong — possesses absolute, inexhaustible, and perfect strength.
The Firm, The Steadfast — steadfast in power; never weakened or diminished in any way.
The Protector, The Guardian — the protecting ally and guardian of the believers.
The Praiseworthy, The Most Praised — inherently deserving of all praise and gratitude.
The All-Enumerating, The Counter — has counted and recorded every single thing in existence.
The Originator, The Initiator — initiates creation from nothing without any prior model.
The Restorer, The Reinstater — will restore and resurrect all creation after death.
The Giver of Life — bestows life upon whomever He wills by His power.
The Creator of Death — decrees death for every soul by His perfect wisdom.
The Ever-Living — possesses absolute, eternal, undying life with no beginning or end.
The Sustainer, The Self-Subsisting — sustains all of creation by His own eternal existence.
The Finder, The Perceiver — finds and perceives all things; nothing escapes His awareness.
The Noble, The Generous — noble and generous in His essence and in His gifts to creation.
The One, The Indivisible — unique and alone in His essence, attributes, and actions.
The Unique, The Only One — absolutely singular with no partners, equals, or division.
The Eternal, The Absolute — the one all creation depends upon; He depends on nothing.
The Omnipotent, The All-Able — able to bring any matter into existence as He wills.
The All-Powerful, The Dominant — exercises His unlimited power with full authority.
The Expediter, The Promoter — advances and promotes whom He wills in rank and provision.
The Delayer, The Postponer — delays and postpones matters by His perfect wisdom and timing.
The First, The Foremost — existed before all creation with no beginning.
The Last, The Utmost — will remain after all creation ceases with no end.
The Manifest, The All-Surpassing — evident through His signs and creation above all things.
The Hidden One, Knower of the Hidden — concealed in His essence; knows all that is hidden.
The Sole Governor — governs and manages all affairs of creation with complete authority.
The Self-Exalted — supremely exalted above all in His attributes and essence.
The Source of All Goodness — the origin of all good; boundlessly kind to His servants.
The Ever-Pardoning — turns toward His servants with mercy whenever they sincerely repent.
The Avenger — exacts just vengeance upon those who persist in wrongdoing and oppression.
The Pardoner — completely erases and wipes away sins, leaving no trace behind.
The Most Kind — full of tenderness and profound compassion toward His servants.
Master of the Dominion, Owner of the Kingdom — the true and absolute possessor of all sovereignty.
Possessor of Glory and Honour — possesses all majesty and is the sole source of honour.
The Just One — establishes absolute justice and equity in all His decrees.
The Gatherer, The Uniter — will gather all of mankind on the Day of Resurrection.
The Self-Sufficient, The Wealthy — completely independent; needs nothing from any of creation.
The Enricher — enriches and satisfies whomever He wills from His boundless treasures.
The Withholder — withholds and prevents by His wisdom; only He can remove what He withholds.
The Distresser — sends trials and hardship by His perfect wisdom and decree.
The Propitious, The Benefactor — brings benefit and good to whomever He wills.
The Light — the source of all light, guidance, and truth in the heavens and the earth.
The Guide — guides whomever He wills to the straight path of truth and salvation.
The Incomparable Originator — creates in ways utterly unprecedented with no equal or model.
The Ever-Lasting — remains forever after all creation perishes; eternal without end.
The Inheritor — inherits all things after creation ceases; the true and final owner.
The Guide to the Right Path — directs all affairs with perfect and flawless wisdom.
The Patient — infinitely patient with His servants and delays in repentance.
